answer: The bridge debit happens at intake, whisper totals the burned amount, and voyage anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm as a result pays the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 9 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. A farm of 20 pays that 166 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
